elements.name: Cloud shell and route ownership
copy: Cloud holds identity, route ownership and entitlement. It is the last transport tried, and authority over a daemon stays with that daemon.
How each machine is reached right now

elements.name: Cloud billing and plan
copy: The daemon, protocol, clients and local transports are Apache 2.0. What is metered is machines, in buckets. Clients never are.
Machines, in buckets. An extra machine is free inside a tier and costs only at a boundary.
Four retries, then a grace period you choose. Enforcement is one soft point.

A fourteen day Enthusiast trial, no card, once per account. Loopback, WSL, LAN, tailnet and SSH were never gated and do not become gated by a billing state, so a lapse while you are at your desk changes nothing.

blocked.reason: Account billing, metering and trials are Phase 5 platform work and are not implemented in M1.
